description: Bridges the unprivileged background page to Thunderbird's calendar manager and credential store. All EWS networking happens in background.js + calendar/ews.js; this API only ever touches calICalendar and nsILoginManager. 'calendarKey' identifies one synced calendar (folder); 'accountId' identifies one EWS login, which may own several synced calendars.

functions.name: registerCalendar
functions.description: Creates (if needed) and registers the Thunderbird calendar for this calendarKey, or updates its display name if it already exists.

functions.name: unregisterCalendar
functions.description: Removes the Thunderbird calendar for this calendarKey. Does not touch any account's stored credentials.

functions.name: applyRemoteChanges
functions.description: Applies a batch of changes fetched from the EWS server (add/modify/delete) to the local calendar cache, notifying Thunderbird's UI.

functions.name: resolveLocalChange
functions.description: Called by background.js after it successfully pushed a user-made local edit to the EWS server, with the server's final version of the item.

functions.name: rejectLocalChange
functions.description: Called by background.js if pushing a user-made local edit to the EWS server failed.

functions.name: saveCredentials
functions.description: Stores (replacing any existing) the EWS username/password for this account in nsILoginManager.

functions.name: getCredentials
functions.description: Returns the stored {username, password} for this account, or null if none is stored.

functions.name: deleteCredentials
functions.description: Removes any stored credentials for this account.

events.name: onLocalChange
events.description: Fired when the Thunderbird user adds, edits, or deletes an event directly in the calendar UI, so background.js can push it to the EWS server.
